reader_summary.overview: I'm your host, Eddie Palmyel, and with me in the studio is my friend and colleague, Nicholas Savos. For this episode, we are excited to have Jamie Lester on the show. Jamie is a hedge fund industry veteran who has worked at firms such as Steinhardt Partners and David Einhorn's Greenlight Capital.

key_points.text: Jamie is also an adjunct professor at Columbia Business School, and he has managed his own investment fund for nine years.

thesis: The episode discusses the book 'Pause to Think,' which compiles 32 mental models into frameworks for better decision-making and happiness. The author argues that while existing literature often focuses on human fallacies, his book provides a prescriptive, actionable guide using original comic strips to make concepts more memorable and applicable to everyday life.
